units.english: The inductive thruster technology used by the Successors is most similar to the ion thrusters used in human space, but the more powerful magnetic fields utilized by these thrusters lets them generate substantially more thrust than any comparable human ion thruster.
units.italian: The inductive thruster technology used by the Successors is most similar to the ion thrusters used in human space, but the more powerful magnetic fields utilized by these thrusters lets them generate substantially more thrust than any comparable human ion thruster.

units.english: Because a reverse thruster must be facing forwards, it must be installed in the weapon section of your ship instead of the engine section.

units.english: This larger set of inductive thrusters is impressively efficient under low power, and produces an equally impressive amount of thrust in its high-power mode. With these, even large and apparently lumbering Successor ships can suddenly become substantially more agile when under threat.
units.italian: This larger set of inductive thrusters is impressively efficient under low power, and produces an equally impressive amount of thrust in its high-power mode. With these, even large and apparently lumbering Successor ships can suddenly become substantially more agile when under threat.

units.english: While not particularly powerful for its size, this set of inductive steering engines is extraordinarily efficient, allowing large Successor vessels to remain relatively nimble even when equipped with very small generators.
units.italian: While not particularly powerful for its size, this set of inductive steering engines is extraordinarily efficient, allowing large Successor vessels to remain relatively nimble even when equipped with very small generators.

units.english: This large reverse thruster sees use in both commerce and warfare, speeding up the traversal of trade routes in the former situation and enhancing combat agility in the latter.
units.italian: This large reverse thruster sees use in both commerce and warfare, speeding up the traversal of trade routes in the former situation and enhancing combat agility in the latter.

units.english: The largest of the Successors' pulsed inductive thrusters, the Veusa is used primarily to propel their large warships and freighters. While its high-performance mode is powerful enough to accelerate even the largest vessels to high speeds, it also drains shield power remarkably quickly; this is clearly meant to be paired with one of the Successors' fast-recharging shield generators.

units.english: The Veusa series of Successor steering units is significantly smaller than comparable human engines, allowing the Successors to gain some flexibility in the engine layouts of their large ships.
units.italian: The Veusa series of Successor steering units is significantly smaller than comparable human engines, allowing the Successors to gain some flexibility in the engine layouts of their large ships.

units.english: While the invertebrate Successors are relatively unaffected, human pilots must take care when using a reverse thruster this large to avoid dangerous g-force stress on the body.
